## Define Gene Sets
```{r}
Gene_Sets <- list()
# Utzschneider NAture Immunology 2020
xl <- read.xlsx("../data/reference_data/Utzschneider_NatImmunology_2020.xlsx", sheet = 5, startRow = 2)
Gene_Sets[["TEX_Utzschneider_2020"]] <- as.vector(na.omit(convert_mouse_to_human_symbols(xl$Symbol)))

Gene_Sets[["TCR_Elliot_2021"]] <- as.vector(na.omit(convert_mouse_to_human_symbols(c("Nr4a1", "Nr4a2", "Nr4a3", "Cd69", "Tnf", "Irf4", "Irf8", "Egr2", "Tnfsf4", "Il2", "Il2ra", "Cd40lg", "Pdcd1", "Tbx21", "Ifng", "Gzmb", "Il12rb2", "Malt1", "Mt1", "Mt2", "Il21", "Rora", "Rorc", "Ctla4", "Icos", "Maf", "Il10", "Nfil3", "Tigit", "Lag3", "Cd3g", "Cd3e", "Lck", "Rasgrp1", "Gata3", "Bhlhe40", "Eomes", "Runx3"))))

# Step 1: Find overlapping genes between any two of the lists
overlap_Bending_Kallies <- intersect(Gene_Sets$TCR_Elliot_2021, Gene_Sets$TEX_Utzschneider_2020)

# Step 2: Remove overlapping genes from each list
Gene_Sets[["TEX_Utzschneider_2020_unique"]] <- setdiff(Gene_Sets$TCR_Elliot_2021, overlap_Bending_Kallies)
Gene_Sets[["TCR_Elliot_2021_unique"]] <- setdiff(Gene_Sets$TEX_Utzschneider_2020, overlap_Bending_Kallies)
```

#-----Annotate of TEX ------ {.tabset .tabset-pills .tabset-fade}
## Reference Map
```{r}
CD8_ref <- load.reference.map(ref = "../data/PTIL_refs/CD8T_human_ref_v1.rds")

library(Seurat)
library(ProjecTILs)

# Prepare a copy; retain the original Tc_8 object
CD8 <- Tc_8

DefaultAssay(CD8) <- "RNA"

CD8@assays$SCT <- NULL

# Preserve projection by sample
CD8 <- Run.ProjecTILs(
  query = Tc_8_project,
  ref = CD8_ref,
  ndim = 10,
  split.by = "orig.ident",
  reduction = "pca",
  filter.cells = FALSE
)

table(CD8$functional.cluster)
```

```{r}
order <- c("CD8.NaiveLike", "CD8.CM", "CD8.EM", "CD8.TEMRA","CD8.TEX","CD8.TPEX", "CD8.MAIT")

Tc_8$functional.cluster <- CD8$functional.cluster
Tc_8$functional.cluster <- factor(Tc_8$functional.cluster, levels = order)
levels(factor(Tc_8$functional.cluster))
Idents(Tc_8) <- "functional.cluster"


Tc_8$Check <- "Check"
table(Tc_8$Check)
table(Tc_8$functional.cluster)

Tc_8@meta.data <- Tc_8@meta.data %>%
mutate(TEX_ref = ifelse(grepl("EX", functional.cluster), "TX", "Other"))

table(Tc_8$Check)
table(Tc_8$TEX_ref)


Tc_8@meta.data <- Tc_8@meta.data %>%
  mutate(
    TEX_ref_full = ifelse(
      grepl("EX", as.character(functional.cluster)),
      "CD8.TX",
      as.character(functional.cluster)
    )
  )

table(Tc_8$Check)
table(Tc_8$TEX_ref_full)

Tc_8$TEX_ref_full <- factor(Tc_8$TEX_ref_full, levels = c("CD8.NaiveLike", "CD8.CM", "CD8.EM", "CD8.TEMRA",  "CD8.MAIT" , "CD8.TX" ))
```

## Manual
```{r}
DefaultAssay(Tc_8) <- "RNA"

genes <- c("TOX", "ICOS", "PDCD1", "TIGIT", "HAVCR2", "ICOS", "LAG3", "IRF4")
thr   <- 0.5

genes_present <- intersect(genes, rownames(Tc_8))
if (!"TOX" %in% genes_present) stop("TOX not found in Tc_8")

expr <- GetAssayData(Tc_8, assay = "RNA", slot = "scale.data")[genes_present, , drop = FALSE]

tox_expr <- expr["TOX", ]
other_genes <- setdiff(genes_present, "TOX")

other_count <- colSums(expr[other_genes, , drop = FALSE] > thr)

# Cells: TOX > thr AND at least 2 of the others > thr
sel <- tox_expr > thr & other_count >= 3

Tex_cells <- colnames(Tc_8)[sel]

# Add to metadata
Tc_8$TEX <- ifelse(colnames(Tc_8) %in% Tex_cells, "TX", "Other")

Tc_8@meta.data <- Tc_8@meta.data %>%
  mutate(
    TEX_full = ifelse(
      colnames(Tc_8) %in% Tex_cells, "CD8 TX",
      as.character(celltype)
    )
  )
```

#----- Heatmaps of TEX Genes ------ {.tabset .tabset-pills .tabset-fade}
## Reference mapped data
```{r}
sc.Avg <- AverageExpression(Tc_8, assays = "RNA", slot = "scale.data", return.seurat = T, group.by = "TEX_ref_full")

Heatmap_Genes <- c("SELL","TCF7","CD44","CD69", "CCL5", "GZMB","GNLY", "TRAV1-2", "TOX","PDCD1","LAG3","IRF4","ICOS")
mtx <- sc.Avg@assays$RNA@layers$scale.data |> as.data.frame()
rownames(mtx) <- rownames(sc.Avg@assays$RNA)
colnames(mtx) <- colnames(sc.Avg@assays$RNA)

gene_col <- "gene"

x <- Heatmap_Genes
mtx_sub <- subset(mtx, rownames(mtx) %in% x)
mtx_sub <- mtx_sub %>% arrange(factor(rownames(mtx_sub), levels = x))

order <- rownames(sc.Avg@meta.data)
order_rev <- order

mtx_sub <- mtx_sub[, match(order_rev, colnames(mtx_sub)), drop = FALSE]

meta <- sc.Avg@meta.data[order_rev, , drop = FALSE]
meta$cluster <- rownames(meta)

cluster_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  cluster = meta$cluster,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  annotation_label = FALSE,
  annotation_name_rot = 5,
  show_legend = FALSE,
  annotation_legend_param = list(labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 0)),
  col = list(cluster = cols$PTILs[levels(factor(meta$cluster))])
)

col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-0.5, 0, 0.5), c("black", "#21918c", "#fde725"))
heatmap_legend_params <- list(
  legend_direction = "horizontal",
  legend_position = "center",
  legend_width = unit(3, "cm"),
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  labels_rot = 0,
  title = "",
  title_gp = gpar(box_fill = "grey"),
  at = c(-1, 0, 1)
)

hm <- Heatmap(
  mtx_sub,
  height = nrow(mtx_sub) * unit(5, "mm"),
  width  = ncol(mtx_sub) * unit(5, "mm"),   # slightly slimmer columns for landscape
  border = TRUE,
  top_annotation = cluster_anno,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  row_names_side = "left",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  cluster_row_slices = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  cluster_column_slices = FALSE,
  column_names_side = NULL,
  row_title = " ",
  column_title = "",
  heatmap_legend_param = heatmap_legend_params
)

svglite("../docs/assets/03-Figure-3/TX_HM_ref.svg", width = 4, height = 4)  # landscape
draw(hm, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")
invisible(dev.off())
knitr::include_graphics("../docs/assets/03-Figure-3/TX_HM_ref.svg")
```

## Clusters split by TEX
```{r}
Idents(Tc_8) <- "celltype"

sc.Avg <- AverageExpression(subset(Tc_8, !c(celltype %in% c("CD8 TN"))), assays = "RNA", slot = "scale.data", return.seurat = T, group.by = c("celltype","TEX"))
```

```{r}
Heatmap_Genes <- c("CD44","CD69", "CCL5", "GZMB","GNLY", "TOX","PDCD1","LAG3","IRF4","ICOS", "TIGIT", "HAVCR2")

# Expression matrix from sc.Avg
mtx <- sc.Avg@assays$RNA@layers$scale.data |> as.data.frame()
rownames(mtx) <- rownames(sc.Avg@assays$RNA)
colnames(mtx) <- colnames(sc.Avg@assays$RNA)

mtx_sub <- mtx[rownames(mtx) %in% Heatmap_Genes, , drop = FALSE]
mtx_sub <- mtx_sub[match(Heatmap_Genes, rownames(mtx_sub)), , drop = FALSE]  # preserve gene order

# Meta for columns + FORCE celltype ordering

# 1) desired order from Seurat object
celltype_levels <- rev(levels(Tc_8$celltype))  # or: levels(Idents(Tc_8)) if that's what you use

# 2) meta for heatmap columns
meta <- sc.Avg@meta.data[colnames(mtx_sub), , drop = FALSE]
meta$celltype <- as.character(meta$celltype)

# 3) apply Tc_8 ordering (keep only levels that actually appear in meta)
celltype_levels_use <- celltype_levels[celltype_levels %in% unique(meta$celltype)]
meta$celltype <- factor(meta$celltype, levels = celltype_levels_use)

# (optional but recommended) if anything didn't match, it becomes NA
stopifnot(!any(is.na(meta$celltype)))

# Ensure TEX labels are consistent (Other vs TX)

# If your meta already has TEX, just standardise its labels.
# This assumes meta$TEX exists and is either "Other"/"TEX" or "Other"/"TX".
meta$TEX <- as.character(meta$TEX)
meta$TEX <- ifelse(meta$TEX %in% c("TX", "TEX"), "TX", "Other")
meta$TEX <- factor(meta$TEX, levels = c("TX", "Other"))


# Order columns: Other first, then TX; within each, by celltype (Tc_8 order)
ord <- with(meta, order(TEX, celltype))
mtx_sub <- mtx_sub[, ord, drop = FALSE]
meta    <- meta[ord, , drop = FALSE]

# Colours
tex_cols <- c("Other" = "grey85", "TX" = "#e812dd")

# cols$celltype must be a NAMED vector: names are celltype labels, values are colours
celltype_cols <- cols$celltype[celltype_levels_use]
stopifnot(!any(is.na(celltype_cols)))  # catches missing names in cols$celltype

top_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  TEX      = meta$TEX,
  celltype = meta$celltype,
  col = list(
    TEX      = tex_cols,
    celltype = celltype_cols
  ),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  annotation_height = unit(c(3, 3), "mm")
)

col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("black", "#21918c", "#fde725"))
heatmap_legend_params <- list(
  legend_direction = "horizontal",
  legend_position = "center",
  legend_width = unit(3, "cm"),
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  labels_rot = 270,
  title = "",
  title_gp = gpar(box_fill = "grey"),
  at = c(-1, 0, 1)
)

hm <- Heatmap(
  mtx_sub,
  height = nrow(mtx_sub) * unit(5, "mm"),
  width  = ncol(mtx_sub) * unit(5, "mm"), 
  col = col_fun,
  border = TRUE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontfamily = "Times"),
  row_names_rot = -45,
  row_names_side = "left",
  top_annotation = top_anno,
  column_split = meta$TEX,
  cluster_column_slices = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  heatmap_legend_param = heatmap_legend_params
)

svglite::svglite("../docs/assets/03-Figure-3/TEX_by_celltype_HM.svg", width = 5, height = 5)
draw(hm, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")
dev.off()
knitr::include_graphics("../docs/assets/03-Figure-3/TEX_by_celltype_HM.svg")
```

## TEX as an independent group.
```{r}

table(Tc_8$TEX_full)
Tc_8$TEX_full <- factor(Tc_8$TEX_full, levels = c("CD8 TN", "CD8 TM","CD8 Tc1DM", "CD8 TCTLDM", "CD8 Tc1-CTLDM", "CD8 TX"))

sc.Avg <- AverageExpression(Tc_8, assays = "RNA", slot = "scale.data", return.seurat = T, group.by = "TEX_full")


Heatmap_Genes <- c("SELL", "TCF7", "CD44","CD69", "CCL5", "GZMB","GNLY", "TOX","PDCD1","LAG3","IRF4","ICOS", "TIGIT", "HAVCR2")

# --- Define the desired order ---
tex_lvls <- c("CD8 TN", "CD8 TM", "CD8 Tc1DM", "CD8 TCTLDM",
              "CD8 Tc1-CTLDM", "CD8 TX")

# --- Enforce factor levels in meta.data ---
sc.Avg$TEX_full <- factor(sc.Avg$TEX_full, levels = tex_lvls)

# --- Reorder the *columns* (pseudo-cells) of sc.Avg to match factor levels ---
# (This is the key step that fixes column ordering everywhere downstream.)
sc.Avg <- sc.Avg[, tex_lvls, drop = FALSE]

mtx <- sc.Avg@assays$RNA@layers$scale.data |> as.data.frame()

# Ensure row/colnames are correct (often already are, but keep defensive)
rownames(mtx) <- rownames(sc.Avg@assays$RNA)
colnames(mtx) <- colnames(sc.Avg)

x <- Heatmap_Genes
mtx_sub <- mtx[rownames(mtx) %in% x, , drop = FALSE]
mtx_sub <- mtx_sub %>% dplyr::arrange(factor(rownames(mtx_sub), levels = x))

# meta in the same order as columns (already ordered by tex_lvls)
meta <- sc.Avg@meta.data[colnames(sc.Avg), , drop = FALSE]
meta$cluster <- as.character(meta$TEX_full)   # use TEX_full, not rownames(meta)

# Build a named colour vector in the same order
cluster_cols <- cols$CD8_withTX[tex_lvls]
names(cluster_cols) <- tex_lvls

cluster_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  cluster = meta$cluster,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  annotation_label = FALSE,
  show_legend = FALSE,
  col = list(cluster = cluster_cols)
)

col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("black", "#21918c", "#fde725"))
```

#----- Representation of TEX Per Cluster - Ref ------ {.tabset .tabset-pills .tabset-fade}
```{r}
df <- subset(Tc_8, TEX_ref == "TX")@meta.data   %>%
  dplyr::count(celltype, TEX_ref) %>%              # count combinations
  group_by(TEX_ref) %>%                      # within each TEX
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%      # calculate %
  ungroup()

TEX_per_cluster_ref <- ggplot(df, aes(x = celltype, y = percent, fill = TEX_ref)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.9, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TX" = "#e812dd", "Other" = "lightgrey")) +
  labs(y = "Percent Exhausted") +
  theme_pubr(base_family = "Times", base_size = txt_pt) +
```

#-----TEX Proportion in Plaque vs. Blood------ {.tabset .tabset-pills .tabset-fade}
```{r}
## Manual
# Build a clean metadata df
Exh_PID <- data.frame(
  Tissue    = Tc_8$PB,
  Patient   = Tc_8$PID,
  Exhausted = Tc_8$TEX
)

# Calculate % exhausted (TEX) per Patient × Tissue
exhausted_pct <- Exh_PID %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Exhausted)) %>%              # optional: drop NAs
  group_by(Patient, Tissue) %>%
  summarise(
    Freq    = sum(Exhausted == "TX"),       # number of TEX cells
    Total   = n(),                           # total cells for that Patient × Tissue
    Percent = 100 * Freq / Total,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Exhausted     = "TX",
    Patient_Group = paste(Patient, Tissue)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Patient, Tissue, Patient_Group, Exhausted, Freq, Percent)

write.csv(
  exhausted_pct,
  file = "../docs/assets/03-Figure-3/Percentages_Exhausted_PB.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Reference Mapped
Exh_PID <- data.frame(
  Tissue    = Tc_8$PB,
  Patient   = Tc_8$PID,
  Exhausted = Tc_8$TEX_ref
)

exhausted_pct <- Exh_PID %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Exhausted)) %>%            
  group_by(Patient, Tissue) %>%
  summarise(
    Freq    = sum(Exhausted == "TX"),       
    Total   = n(),                          
    Percent = 100 * Freq / Total,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Exhausted     = "TX",
    Patient_Group = paste(Patient, Tissue)
  ) %>%

write.csv(
  exhausted_pct,
  file = "../docs/assets/03-Figure-3/Percentages_Exhausted_PB_referencemapped.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
Idents(Tc_8) <- "Tissue"

unstable_vs_stable <- FindMarkers(subset(Tc_8, celltype != "CD8 TN"), ident.1 = "Unstable", ident.2 = "Stable", min.pct = 0.2, logfc.threshold = 0, only.pos = F, test.use = "MAST", verbose = F)

unstable_vs_stable$gene <- rownames(unstable_vs_stable)
```

#-----Correlation between Exhaustion and TCR Signalling------
```{r}
p8 <- subset(Tc_8, PB == "Plaque")

Correlations <- data_frame(
  "Exhaustion" = p8$TEX_Utzschneider_2020_UCell,
  "TCR Signalling" = p8$TCR_Elliot_2021_UCell)

# Create bins
Correlations$Exhaustion_Bin <- cut(Correlations$`TCR Signalling`, 
                                          breaks = 100, 
                                          labels = FALSE)

# Group by the Exhaustion bin and calculate the mean for each metric
Correlations_binned <- Correlations %>%
  group_by(Exhaustion_Bin) %>%
  summarise(across(c("Exhaustion", "TCR Signalling"), mean, na.rm = TRUE))

write.csv(Correlations_binned, file = "../docs/assets/03-Figure-3/Correlations_binned.csv")
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(broom)

## ---- Fit model on binned means ----
lm_bin <- lm(Exhaustion ~ `TCR Signalling`, data = Correlations_binned)
lm_sum <- summary(lm_bin)
r2_bin <- lm_sum$r.squared
p_bin  <- coef(lm_sum)[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]

## ---- Plot regression on binned data ----
regression <- ggplot(Correlations_binned,
       aes(x = `TCR Signalling`, y = Exhaustion)) +
  
  # Binned mean points
  geom_point(size = 2, shape = 21,
             fill = "#A6CEE3", colour = "black") +
  
  # Linear regression on *binned* values
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
              colour = "#DE2D26", size = 1.2) +
  
  # Annotation
  annotate("text",
           x = Inf, y = Inf,
           hjust = 1.5, vjust = 1.5,
           label = paste0(
             "R² = ", round(r2_bin, 3), 
             "\nP = ", signif(p_bin, 3)
           ),
           size = txt_mm, family = "Times") +
  
  labs(
    x = "Elliot 2021 \n TCR Signalling UCell Score",
    y = "Utzschneider 2020 \n Exhaustion UCell Score"
  ) +
  
  theme_pubr(base_family = "Times", base_size = txt_pt) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, size = 1),
    axis.text    = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    axis.title   = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    aspect.ratio = 1
  )


Gene_Sets$TEX_Utzschneider_2020_unique
```
